subject: Customer spotlight: thank-you options and donation receipt logistics
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer spotlight: thank-you options and donation receipt logistics

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for agreeing to participate in a short customer spotlight video — we really appreciate ClearPort making time for this. To say thanks we typically offer one of three options:

1) Account credit ($1,000 USD) applied to ClearPort's Redwood account;
2) Gift card bundle ($500 USD) + a small Redwood swag pack shipped to your HQ;
3) Donation to a charity of your choice (we can issue a donation receipt in ClearPort's name).

Quick ask: which option would you prefer? If you pick the donation, please confirm the legal payee name and any billing address you need on the receipt. If you pick swag, let me know a shipping contact and preferred hat/hoodie sizes (we'll include a playbook + sticker pack).

I've attached a one-page sample of the swag pack and a short checklist for the spotlight session. If you'd like, we can also expedite a DocuSign receipt draft for procurement.

Sample attachments referenced: swag-sample.jpg (image), spotlight-checklist.pdf (doc)

Next steps: once you pick an option we'll coordinate with finance/billing and fulfillment.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the video.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
